facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices

facts.title: high potential incident during transfer operations on PSV-7101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-7101 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-7101 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 31 May 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on PSV-7101 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during transfer operations; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
